notes.title: FaeVerse Alchemy Reborn Update 2.0.25b
notes.content:
FaeVerse Alchemy Rerborn has been rebuilt from the ground up. 

Overview on changes:
• Versus Mode has been removed and replaced with Chronos Mode
• Rings have been removed, when crafting is added they’ll be added back in
• Chronos Mode a new time based mode 
• Chaos and Chornos mode have 3 sub mode with slightly altered rules
• Loot collected at the end of a round can be used as equipped items in various modes
• Every mode has their own high score stats 
• Abyss Mode is still a single chance to get a high score for the day, but players can retry to get a personal best
• Puzzle Mode has additional puzzles added and more to come
• Every mode has their own set of achievements now 
• Achievement requirements were adjusted for older achievements
• Updated help screen
• All items you’ve used can be viewed again in the help screen
• Various modes players can select what high tier elements they want to transmute into, currently there is only Rune and Fire elements
• Updated all item visuals and sound effects 
• Many many more under the hood changes

If you were playing the FVA 2016 build and want to finish any achievements you can still complete them for now swapping over to the fva_2016 beta branch. This branch will be publicly available for a few months.

[h2]Update 2.0.26b[/h2]
• Added setting to change the windowed resolution
• Added setting to automatically set the windowed mode to be maximized

notes.title: FAERIE SOLITAIRE HARVEST LIBRARY UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34607415/b8565891ea13bb5dbed156e0ebd73da4347a7b5a.png[/img]

[b]If you have not reviewed FSH yet please do![/b] Every review counts and is greatly appreciated! Total reviews help drive sales, which means more free updates like this one are possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/348910/Faerie_Solitaire_Harvest/

We've been hard at work since launch improving and polishing Faerie Solitaire Harvest to be even better than before. Besides tons of extra attention to detail and optimizations, we've also included an entirely new section to the game we are calling the Library.

Behold the exciting new additions of this update:

 - New Talents where you can gain new powerful abilities.
 - New Lore to discover as you play the game.
 - New Valor for greater risk and reward.

Unlock the Blab talent ASAP! :)

-------------------

[b]Want the patch notes? Here they are:[/b]

[quote]
ENTER THE LIBRARY!
Unlock Powerful Talents! 
Discover Fascinating Lore! 
Show Your Valor!

__________________________________________________________

Goal Changes
- Changing "No Wild" to "Using a Wild".

- Added "Never Break a Combo", worth 1,000 pure.
- Added "Celestial" combo tier, worth 1,000 pure.

- Increasing "Using Wild" bonus from 100 to 150 pure.
- Increasing "No Spare" bonus from 100 pure to 200 pure.
- Increasing "No Deck" bonus from 100 pure to 500 pure.
- Increasing "All-Out" bonus from 1000 pure to 2000 pure.
- Increasing "Left over Deck" bonus multiplier from x5 to x10. Example: (26 cards in a deck = 260 pure).
- Increasing "Highest Combo" bonus multiplier from x10 to x15. Example: (22 combo = 330 pure).

__________________________________________________________

Drop changes
- Adjusted drop rates.
    - Decreased Pet drop rates ~5%.
    - Decreased Item drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased Resource drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased bonus from NGP bonus ~5%.
(Note these are done in part for the new talents buffing drop rates by a lot more.)

__________________________________________________________

Valor
- Added New Valor system.

Valor is an optional system that will allow players to give themselves a more difficult playthrough.

You must meet the conditions to unlock each of the 7 Valor perks.

Each Valor perk you have enabled will increase the maximum amount of XP you get per completed hand and other benifits.

__________________________________________________________

Valor XP/Leveling
- Added New XP/Leveling system.
    - Every level will grant players 1 Talent point.
    - After reaching level 100, your next level up will reset your level to 1 and give you 1 Prestige Level.

Currently Prestige Levels do not grant anything special and are just for bragging rights (you still gain a bonus per each normal level up).

__________________________________________________________

Talents
- Added New Talent system.

We've added in 36 Talents into the game. These Talents will buff various different parts of the game as you play.

You will need Talent points and pure to unlock Talent perks. The cost of talent points and pure will depend on the Talents' Rank.

Some Talent Perks can be upgraded past their initial rank.

You gain Talent points from completing locations (finishing all 9 hands and freeing the faerie or unlocking a loot box) and from leveling up.

Plus a ton of extra random polish, love, and care!

[/quote]

Please enjoy this update and look forward to our next game Dire.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/556530/Faerie_Solitaire_Dire/

Want to join our Discord community? Check the in game about screen for invite links!

notes.title: Version 1.0.15.10.10
notes.content:
We've updated FVA to latest public version. Windows build is available, Mac, Linux later today possibly tomorrow. Note that only Windows has Steam achievements enabled still. Others will be enabled when we can focus on them.

We've been working on more features and content, but we're not making it public yet. I wish we could show more now but most is just not polished enough yet or features we're still experimenting with. But we wanted to put something new up as it's been a while.

- 10 new locations in explore mode. Not final art.
- 1 new zone in explode mode. Over time we'll expand out the map, and add more worlds/ zones.
- Pure Mode is now available - it plays like the original Faerie Alchemy without any item drops at all.
- Screen shake added - you can disable it in options

Locations have goals. We have not added the English text for it but most are obvious. BoardItemCount# means you need so many items of rank # on the board at once. You do not need to reach the score threshold to finish goals.

Do not worry about suggesting features / polish for explore related content for now unless you find a crashing bug. Some of the assets in now are older and will be replaced. Most likely next update we will be ready for feedback on explore content and features.

For now, you can go to the World button on the Nexus screen to access [Vanguard Reach] Hearthvhan, Lostria. Later on there will be an inbetween screen in which you go to different worlds, such as Gaea or Lunaeris, and the different lore campaigns/zone regions of each world.

Lostria is a world cursed, taken by the darkness of the abyss, touched by chaos, and blighted by the evil, unspeakable spawns birthed by Mogmarrow's meddling with the verse. A land betrayed by its once savior, with its people swallowed whole. Their dreams, loves, glory, family, and peace all forever lost.

There are those who would see this world taken back, some who came from those who fled when the world was originally lost, and want their homelands back. You will help them cleanse the lands, and unlock the secrets buried below the dark hazes.

Right now this is not enabled, but later there will be stages to locations where they begin as "abyss" and can be cleansed to become normal again. As you clear up more locations, other zones open. NPCs can be unlocked, saved, summoned, who have things to say, and things they want done. There are faeries to free too. Plush fishing and pet battling.

Other worlds/zones have other kinds of meta mechanics planned for their Explore mode versions.

Here is our rough todo for immediate future: 

1. We're going to focus on getting the long awaited Faerie Solitaire Remastered up as a free optional launch option for all current owners, and we may publish one or more side projects on mobile and maybe on Steam too as free games. We've been working on the main projects for years and the side projects keep us almost sane.
2. After Faerie Solitaire Remastered is done w'ere focusing back on FVA and we'll begin to do major named updates back to back unlocking long in progress content. A great deal of this work directly contributes to getting FVS ready. Once we get FVA to a truly full game state we will publish it out of Early Access, but that won't be the end to development - I want to update it long term.
3. After FVA is gold we'll focus on finally getting FaeVerse Solitaire all polished up and ready to ship too. FVS will also be updated long term.

NO RELEASE DATES. But 2015 is almost over and it getting nearly over makes me super anxious! This year has been a blur of work! Going back to it!

ːleaffaerieː

notes.title: Version 1.0.15.01.21
notes.content:
Added Game Mode Abyss: Testing a new game mode, No equips. All items spawn as shadows. Play once per day.

New Special Modifiers for Elements
- Shadow: Doesn't contribute to score.
- Enchanted: When transmuted goes to the next higher tier (enchantment loses charge after transmutation) 
- Frozen: Elements frozen can't transmute for 2-3 turns.
- Haunted: Moves randomly freezes adjacent pieces.
- Plagued: Moves randomly can't transmutate next to it.
- Cursed: 3x transmutations turn to dust, 4x+ breaks curse. 
- Sticky: Piece doesn't fall.
- Burning: Turns into char.

Changed the way Lustrous Coin works, now each piece has a 50% chance to become shiny.
Voltbelt is now more lethal but lowered the % chance to %5 per transmutation.

Added Burnt Char: To break this item you must do transmutations next to it.
Added Return Potion: Moves the board back one step.
Added Frost Dagger: When dropped freezes piece below it and after the piece loses it's frozen state breaks that item.
Added War Hook: Brings the item below the item it is dropped on to the top of the stack.
Added Rising Fall: Destroys all items in a X shaped angle.
Added Wooden Broom: 50% chance to destroy elements that are tier 3 and below. Has 100% chance to destroy Vagrant Dust.

Elements 9-12 can now be randomly selected in the equips again.

Ability to change the speed of fade in/out for pieces. 

Fixed a bug when pressing Escape on various screens.
Fixed a bug with Corrupted Seed.
Removed "10 to 10000" puzzle.

[quote]
__________________
1.0.14.6.27 Update #8

- There are now "ghosted" drop previews which appear where pieces will drop on game board
- Some changes to puzzle level metadata
- Lots of behind the scenes work (see End of June 2014 State of Dev in Secret forum)
- Two new RunePets added to for now random pool (#3 Shalazaul & #18 Knigarl)
[/quote]


Windows: Up
Mac: Up
Linux: Up


Basic adventure mode stuff didn't make this build. We decided since the new world map stuff interacts with save data in big ways we don't want to risk corrupting current data so while things are still actively changing in world map data we are going to first put it all (world map + NPC stuff) into RunePets stand alone. First RP standalone build is around the corner.


Here's an ink concept of Shalazaul: http://i.imgur.com/d43LJ8j.png

- Two new RunePets added to for now random pool (#3 Shalazaul & #18 Knigarl)
[/quote]


Windows: Up
Mac: Up
Linux: Up


Basic adventure mode stuff didn't make this build. We decided since the new world map stuff interacts with save data in big ways we don't want to risk corrupting current data so while things are still actively changing in world map data we are going to first put it all (world map + NPC stuff) into RunePets stand alone. First RP standalone build is around the corner.


Here's an ink concept of Shalazaul: http://i.imgur.com/d43LJ8j.png
